toneRules: Preserve the source's confidence while grounding claims in behavior and decision quality.
Translate metaphysical language into practical self-command without mocking the source.
prohibitedChanges: Do not make unsupported medical, financial, or supernatural claims.
Do not imply Florence Scovel Shinn wrote the adaptation.
Do not reduce the work to generic affirmation content.
coreLessons: Expectation changes what people notice and attempt.
Fearful speech can reinforce fearful action.
A disciplined inner life improves outer decisions.
Intuition deserves attention but must be paired with judgment.
The game is played through repeated choices, not wishes alone.
